Product:{\"sku\":\"7100131967\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
"holoVillage: Our Cozy Days" is a game where you can live a carefree, laid-back life in a fantasy village together with your oshi.

■ Enjoy a relaxing slow life of farming, mining, fishing, and more
In the village, you can till your fields, go fishing, craft with the materials you've gathered, open a shop to sell equipment, join the mini lives held on the beach… Play however you like and spend easygoing days with hololive members.

■ hololive talents come to your village
You can welcome familiar hololive talents to your village as villagers and live alongside them.
Of course they can lend a hand with farm work and other tasks, but you can also have them wear your favorite outfits, take photos together, and more...
As your Friendship grows, you may receive all kinds of gifts, such as lovely profile cards unique to each character and furniture.

Take your time and build up memories together.

■ Exciting dungeon exploration
Vast fields stretch out beyond the village.
All sorts of enemies appear, and there are even dungeons where powerful bosses lie in wait! You can enjoy thrilling adventures, too.
Make the most of multiple weapon types, equipment customization and upgrades through smithing, the Job Ability tree, and more to reach ever greater heights!

■ In-depth room design (housing)
In the rooms of your house and shop, you can freely arrange hololive-themed furniture, goods, and more to create an interior that's truly your own.
There are over 1,800 kinds of furniture!
Placement is extremely flexible: stack furniture on top of other furniture many layers high, hang items on the walls, and more.
You can also upload and publish the room you're proud of to the server, or go visit your friends' rooms.

■ A huge variety of costumes and character customization
In this game, you can create your own character and change outfits.
Create a character that reflects yourself, or dress up as your favorite hololive talent...
There are over 1,300 costumes and character creation parts in total!
You can even have villagers wear the outfits you like.
